llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed paid-ad measurement workflow that reads user-provided campaign exports and writes scoped local summaries/ledger entries for follow-up analysis.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, inputs, and outputs fit together: it compares paid campaign changes against controls, normalizes ROAS/CPA evidence, delegates math, and returns a Promote/Keep-testing/Rollback/Unproven decision.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to user-owned campaign exports and explicitly warn not to execute instructions embedded in CSVs, campaign names, or labels.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only SKILL.md with no executable bundled files, install hooks, background workers, or hidden setup steps; static scan and VirusTotal telemetry were clean.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It can invoke a local ledger helper and optionally use ad-platform APIs, but the artifacts frame APIs as optional and the ledger data is limited to campaign measurement fields needed for the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses local persistence to memory/open-loops.md and memory/ad/paid-measurement-loop/, and Save Results requires user confirmation; the ledger snapshot instruction is purpose-aligned but users should be aware it stores campaign metrics locally.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the skill analyze your paid-ad exports and store campaign performance summaries locally. Review where your host stores memory and ledger files, especially if campaign revenue, spend, or conversion data is sensitive.
llm.findings: [SDI-1] expected: The artifact does instruct writing campaign metrics to a ledger and saving readback summaries, but this is disclosed in the Skill Contract and Save Results section, scoped to paid-campaign measurement, and not evidence of hidden or unrelated persistence.
